Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5104090. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to include canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
